import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    if len(data) < 1 + n:
        print(0)
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    print(sum(arr))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
